system.description: Child -> Armor routes that no Vital Bracelet card has (step 16, docs/digimon/step16-golden-digimentals.md). Each one is a pair of Wikimon's Digimental Evolution Chart (the Child with that Armor under that Digimental), kept only on a line that already has both Digimon. The Armor keeps its card stage (research/armor-routes.json `cardStages`), so these routes skip stages: a Child lands straight on a Perfect or an Ultimate. Growth never takes them; only the Digimental does. An Ultimate Armor graduates; a Perfect one grows on by its card's routes. The card's own routes into these Armors stay as they are.
system.source: https://wikimon.net/Template:DigimentalEvoList1 (shown on https://wikimon.net/Digimental_Evolution_Chart), fetched 2026-11-21. Text licensed CC BY-SA 3.0. The pairs are copied in research/armor-routes.json `system.digimentalChart.pairs`; gen_catalog.py checks every route below against them.
system.decided: user, 2026-11-22: Miracles and Fate are golden (never as fragments); Kindness comes from fragments like the other eight.
system.routes: `digimentals`: every Digimental that opens the step (either one does). `chart`: the chart pair(s), as Wikimon writes the names.
